description: §6.13.5 (S479): a `debounced=1s` engine cell. Click #load (Idle -> Loading is held), advance the 1s window: the held write commits and the engine transitions to Loading. Then click #finish (Loading -> Done) with NO time advanced: that write is still held, so the cell stays Loading — the transition happens at commit, not at the write. XFAIL on impl#1: it parses neither the §66 `single` engine opener nor a timed engine (S471 policy: impl#1 is frozen; carried gap g-impl1-timed-engine-commit-s479).
rationale: §6.13.5: "A `debounced=` / `throttled=` engine cell **transitions at commit**. A write to it is held by the timing rule like any other local write, and the transition happens when the held value commits: `rule=` (§51.0.F) is judged at the commit, against the variant the cell holds then". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — the rest of S478 hand-off §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 8.
